providerFacts: Tickets acknowledge Expo acceptance; receipts describe handoff to platform services, not physical display. Provider recommends delayed receipt polling and retry/backoff for rejection/connection errors; downstream delivery may duplicate or fail.
applicationChoice: Durable business event/user/device dedupe and bounded known-rejection retries. Ambiguous acceptance becomes UNKNOWN with no blind resend; this conservative choice is ours, not an Expo exactly-once guarantee or vendor requirement.
evidenceBoundary: Injected provider adapters plus real PG/API/Redis tests only. No external Expo send, configured release credentials or physical-device delivery evidence.
